bug_semantics: Stored XSS in Leads Notes and Attachments. An authenticated user saves HTML in HorillaAttachment.description (the Notes field) through django-summernote. On Edit, the list-row pencil issues hx-get to notes_attachment_edit, HorillaAttachmentForm reloads that HTML into Summernote, and django-summernote does $sn.html(origin.value) / copies it into .note-editable with no sanitization, so a payload such as executes. The same stored string is also emitted with {{ obj.description|safe }} on the note detail view. Affected 1.0.0–1.0.2; advisory patch is fc5c8e55988e89273012491b5f097b762b474546 in 1.0.3.
flaw_origin: The root [INIT] commit first bound Notes to django-summernote's unsanitized widget (SummernoteWidget, later renamed to SummernoteInplaceWidget) and first rendered stored notes with |safe. HorillaAttachment.description was a plain CharField with no bleach/DOMPurify on save, and global.js had no Summernote html() hook. The in-page editor path that the named global.js patch intercepts is that same Notes widget, not a later independent sink.

reasoning: CVE-2026-3050 is a published VulDB record (not rejected) for stored XSS in Horilla CRM Leads Notes via static/assets/js/global.js / Summernote, with a public PoC: persist HTML in Notes and click the list Edit pencil. The sink is HorillaAttachment.description stored without sanitization, then re-injected as HTML by django-summernote on the edit form and by |safe on the detail template. The named patch does not change those first-written lines; it adds a parent-page DOMPurify wrapper around Summernote .note-editable html() and ships purify.min.js, which is present in 1.0.3 and absent from 1.0.2. git log -L/-S show those Notes widget and |safe lines originate in root commit 14ca79728363441de177fdfb318f203113b816c5, which also already wires Leads notes_attachments and the Edit pencil to notes_attachment_edit. That commit has no parent (rev-list --parents / cat-file verified), and no finer public member exists, so it is the BIC rather than the later InplaceWidget rename.
